description: Find mailing list messages related to a commit, topic, or PR. A postgres commit SHA (7-40 hex) returns the mail that refers to that commit (match_mode commit): its Discussion: threads first, then the committers announcement, then messages citing the hash, each with how_it_refers. Anything else searches subject and Message-ID fields via case-insensitive substring; if that returns no hits and an embedding provider is configured, falls back to semantic search across all inboxes.

query.description: Search term (subject keyword, Message-ID substring, or commit hash)

name: find_related_discussions
